'''''Aechmea fulgens''''', the '''coralberry''', is a [[Bromeliaceae|bromeliad]], which is often used as an [[ornamental plant]]. This plant grows in [[Brazil]], especially in the following states: [[Bahia]] and [[Pernambuco]]. It has an upright open rosette shape and after blooming, becomes a reddish orange. It blooms one time before dying.
